verdicts.reason: Both are unusable. Neither shows the headline, the URL or the HOSMART wordmark, and the blue band is an empty shape. A leaves most of the canvas as white dead space, shrinks the hand photo to a thin strip next to an empty grey bar, and puts the white-outline device logo on white, where it barely shows. B also has no text, and its white diagonal stripes float loose as scattered fragments, but it spreads the logo, band and photo down the canvas in a slightly more deliberate vertical order, so it is marginally less broken.
